name: PA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Brendan Boyle with $5.6M cash on hand
Republican challenger with no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: Boyle holds a heavily Democratic Philadelphia-area seat, has a large financial advantage, and faces a challenger with no visible fundraising or outside support; markets price this as a near-certain Democratic hold.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or an unexpectedly strong challenger campaign would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Brendan Boyle is seeking another term in a Philadelphia-area district that leans Democratic by about nineteen points. He enters the race with a strong financial position, including more than $5.5 million on hand, and no outside groups are spending against him.

Republican challenger Jessica Arriaga has no reported fundraising and no outside backing, and no public polling of the race exists. Prediction markets put Boyle's chances around 97 percent. The combination of the district's partisan lean, Boyle's incumbency and resources, and the challenger's minimal campaign infrastructure makes this a Safe Democratic seat with little realistic prospect of an upset.
